dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: ...Well, there are still some affected Wenut nearby. If you've got the time, please help take care of them.

response.speaker: Vinayak
response.text: Wonderful! Why, this is the best opportunity to test the full output of the Wenutslayer Cannon, if I do say so myself!

response.speaker: Vinayak
response.text: Sure. Just come to me when you have the time.
